name: Marcos Javier Alvarez
headline: Principal Engineer · Production LLM and Agent Systems in Regulated Lending
shortSummary: Principal Engineer at Dark Matter Technologies, ex-Staff at House Numbers: production LLM and agent systems for regulated mortgage lending, with cost discipline, evaluation and observability.
summary: Principal Engineer at Dark Matter Technologies, previously Staff Engineer at House Numbers, specialized in taking AI from demo to production in regulated mortgage lending. Over the past four years I have built LLM pipelines for document data extraction, communication infrastructure that syncs and classifies email and SMS at scale, and agentic workflows that are tested, cost-traced, and measured like any other engineering system. What I care about most is the gap between an AI demo and an AI system: evaluation harnesses, human-graded ground truth, cost discipline, and observability. Full-stack range across event-driven backends, React frontends, and infrastructure.
